## What's new

- **Full-screen background.** The Home background now fills the whole screen edge to edge, with no bars on the sides or top. It zooms to fit and never stretches the image.
- **More choices in Edit Artwork:**
  - **Landscape** (new): an optional horizontal image for the game cards in Continue Playing and All Games. When you pick one, the card doesn't add the logo on top, because these images usually include it.
  - **Icon** (new): the square icon used by Save Icon to Photos and the Shortcuts app.
  - Each section now explains where its image is used: Background, Landscape, Cover, Logo and Icon.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
